EXACT 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen full figure poses, same constant size and foot anchor, equal square cells with broad transparent margins and gutters. Row 1 front-three-quarter: windup, preparation, strike release, recovery. Row 2 true rear-three-quarter: same attack sequence, shoulder blades and back of head visible, no face. Row 3 front-three-quarter: jump takeoff, airborne tuck, forward dash, slide brake. Row 4 true rear-three-quarter: same four acrobatics from back, no face. Chibi proportions, crisp outlined pixel clusters, same colors and scale as reference, no motion trails, no scene, no text, transparent background. Do not clip hands or feet.
